payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precompute coverage counts up to 2 per section. For each painter i, compute array Y where Y[k] counts sections that become uncovered if k is also removed, given i removed. Then max painted = totalCovered - min_{k} Y[k] - sectionsCoveredOnlyBy_i.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively tries all pairs of removed painters: it fixes the first, then selects the second to minimize lost sections. While not formal backtracking, it performs a complete search over combinations without recursion, hence weak match to the subtype.
